definition: A model with two parts: a geometric morphology reasoner and a renderer. The reasoner builds a cascaded cost volume for source view sequences. The renderer infers geometric and appearance representations using a Transformer-based attention mechanism and cascaded cost volumes, then renders fine images using volume rendering.
